description: Four passes of unstructured 'Critique and improve your previous review' without a coverage gate, typed delta operations, or epistemic silence.

passHistory.notes: Initial pass identical in coverage decay to single-shot: catches GT-5, GT-6, GT-8, misses unrouted wizard and cross-file privacy breach, triggers SQLi decoy and orphan modal.

Catches GT-1 (dashboard catch block missing setIsLoading(false)) and GT-7 (missing tenant_id check on members), but never retracts the SQLi false positive or the dead modal finding because no voice is tasked with falsification.

Asked to refine again, the model manufactures 4 speculative style/architecture complaints (PropTypes/TypeScript migration, CSS class naming conventions, React.memo wrapping, aria-label nitpicks) rather than going quiet.

Compelled to produce output on Pass 4, adds 5 more low-signal nitpicks (extracting magic numbers, adding barrel index.js files, dark mode tokens, telemetry wrappers, error boundary boilerplate) and summarizes away exact line anchors.
